WITH plays AS (

  FROM play_totals WHERE counted_plays > 0 AND last_counted_at <= ?
  UNION ALL
  SELECT play_events.track_id, max(play_events.album_id), count(*),
    sum("play_events"."listened_ms"), max("play_events"."started_at")
  FROM play_totals CROSS JOIN play_events ON play_events.track_id = play_totals.track_id
  WHERE play_totals.last_counted_at > ? AND play_events.counted
    AND play_events.started_at <= ?
  GROUP BY play_events.track_id),

  SELECT track_id, artist_id, position FROM track_artists

WITH plays AS (
  SELECT track_id, album_id, counted_plays AS plays, counted_listened_ms AS listened,
    last_counted_at AS latest
  FROM play_totals WHERE counted_plays > 0 AND last_counted_at <= ?
  UNION ALL
  SELECT play_events.track_id, max(play_events.album_id), count(*),
    sum("play_events"."listened_ms"), max("play_events"."started_at")
  FROM play_totals CROSS JOIN play_events ON play_events.track_id = play_totals.track_id
  WHERE play_totals.last_counted_at > ? AND play_events.counted
    AND play_events.started_at <= ?
  GROUP BY play_events.track_id),
      credited AS (
  SELECT track_id, artist_id, position FROM track_artists
  UNION ALL
  SELECT track_id, artist_id, position FROM deleted_track_artists),
      -- Each song's first credited position, once (as a correlated subquery
      -- per row it cost ten times the rest at 10,000 songs on 1,000 albums).
      firsts AS (SELECT track_id, min(position) AS position FROM credited GROUP BY track_id)
      SELECT albums.id AS "albumId", albums.title_sort AS "albumSort",
        artists.id AS "artistId", artists.sort AS "artistSort",
        credited.position = firsts.position AS "primary",
        sum(plays.plays) AS "countedPlays", sum(plays.listened) AS "listenedMs",
        max(plays.latest) AS "latestPlayAt"
      FROM plays
      LEFT JOIN tracks ON tracks.id = plays.track_id
      JOIN albums ON albums.id = coalesce(tracks.album_id, plays.album_id)
      JOIN credited ON credited.track_id = plays.track_id
      JOIN firsts ON firsts.track_id = plays.track_id
      JOIN artists ON artists.id = credited.artist_id
      GROUP BY albums.id, artists.id, "primary"

WITH links AS (
  SELECT track_id, artist_id FROM track_artists
  UNION
  SELECT tracks.id, album_artists.artist_id
  FROM tracks JOIN album_artists ON album_artists.album_id = tracks.album_id)
    SELECT artists.id AS "id", artists.name AS "name", artists.sort AS "sort",
      (SELECT count(*) FROM albums WHERE albums.album_artist_id = artists.id) AS "albumCount",
      count(links.track_id) AS "trackCount",
      artwork.thumb_path AS "thumbPath", artwork.path AS "artworkPath"
    FROM artists JOIN links ON links.artist_id = artists.id
    LEFT JOIN artwork ON artwork.hash = artists.artwork_hash
    WHERE artists.id IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    GROUP BY artists.id
    ORDER BY artists.sort, artists.id

SELECT

      (SELECT count(DISTINCT artist_id) FROM (
  SELECT track_id, artist_id FROM track_artists
  UNION
  SELECT tracks.id, album_artists.artist_id
  FROM tracks JOIN album_artists ON album_artists.album_id = tracks.album_id)) AS "artists",
      (SELECT count(DISTINCT album_id) FROM tracks) AS "albums",
      (SELECT count(*) FROM tracks) AS "songs",
      (SELECT count(DISTINCT genre_id) FROM tracks) AS "genres",
      (SELECT count(*) FROM favorites JOIN tracks ON tracks.id = favorites.track_id

        WHERE pi.yt_song IS NOT NULL AND NOT pi.deleted AND NOT p.deleted
